Select approved drugs with mechanism of action classified as INHIBITOR. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno, and target_dictionary on tid. Filter where max_phase equals 4 and action_type is INHIBITOR. Include canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
